questionText:
Arrange the following events related to India's external relations in
chronological order.
 
(A) The then External Affairs Minister, Atal Behari Vajpayee visited China
after full diplomatic relations between India and China were restored.
(B)The Panchsheel Agreement was signed between India and China.
(C) The Shimla Agreement between Indira Gandhi and Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
was signed.
(D) The Kargil conflict
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Politics in India Since Independence (Chapter 4: India's External Relations): (B) Panchsheel Agreement was signed on 29 April 1954 between Nehru and Zhou Enlai. (C) Shimla Agreement was signed on 2 July 1972 following the Bangladesh Liberation War. (A) Atal Bihari Vajpayee as External Affairs Minister visited China in February 1979 (following the resumption of diplomatic ties in 1976). (D) Kargil conflict took place in May-July 1999. Sequence: (B) [1954] -> (C) [1972] -> (A) [1979] -> (D) [1999].
Hence, option (C) is correct.
